```{r setup, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(message = FALSE, warning = FALSE, echo = FALSE)

repo_candidates <- unique(normalizePath(c(
  getwd(),
  file.path(getwd(), ".."),
  file.path(getwd(), "..", ".."),
  file.path(getwd(), "..", "..", "..")
), mustWork = FALSE))
repo_hit <- vapply(repo_candidates, function(path) {
  desc <- file.path(path, "DESCRIPTION")
  file.exists(desc) && any(grepl("^Package: CellEdgeR$", readLines(desc)))
}, logical(1))
root_dir <- if (any(repo_hit)) repo_candidates[which(repo_hit)[1]] else NA_character_
use_local <- !is.na(root_dir)
```

```{r libs}
if (use_local && requireNamespace("devtools", quietly = TRUE)) {
  devtools::load_all(root_dir)
} else if (!requireNamespace("CellEdgeR", quietly = TRUE)) {
  stop("Install CellEdgeR or run this report inside the repo with devtools::load_all().")
}
if (!requireNamespace("dplyr", quietly = TRUE)) {
  stop("Install dplyr.")
}
if (!requireNamespace("tidyr", quietly = TRUE)) {
  stop("Install tidyr.")
}

library(CellEdgeR)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)

helpers_path <- if (use_local) {
  file.path(root_dir, "analysis", "hochchulz_2022_melanoma", "hochschulz_2022_melanoma_shared.R")
} else {
  "analysis/hochchulz_2022_melanoma/hochschulz_2022_melanoma_shared.R"
}
if (!file.exists(helpers_path)) {
  stop("Missing helper script at: ", helpers_path)
}
source(helpers_path)
```

```{r cache-load}
cache_dir <- if (use_local) file.path(root_dir, "analysis", "cache") else tempdir()
base_cache <- file.path(cache_dir, "hochschulz_base.rds")
if (!file.exists(base_cache)) {
  stop("Base cache not found: ", base_cache, ". Run hochschulz_2022_melanoma_base.Rmd first.")
}

base <- readRDS(base_cache)
graphs <- base$graphs
edge_cut <- base$edge_cut
sample_df <- base$sample_df
coef_name <- base$coef_name
group_col <- base$params$group_col
include_wedge <- isTRUE(base$params$include_wedge)
n_cores <- base$params$n_cores
```

```{r params}
n_perm <- 20
perm_seed <- 100
force_run <- FALSE
```

```{r run}
perm_cache <- file.path(cache_dir, "hochschulz_perm_volume_filter_v3.rds")
perm_ran <- FALSE

if (!force_run && file.exists(perm_cache)) {
  perm_pvals <- readRDS(perm_cache)$perm_pvals
} else {
  set.seed(perm_seed)
  perm_ids <- seq_len(n_perm)

  run_perm <- function(i) {
    gperm <- permute_graph_labels(graphs, seed = perm_seed + i)
    cperm <- count_motifs_graphs(
      graph_obj = gperm,
      max_edge_len = edge_cut,
      include_wedge = include_wedge,
      n_cores = n_cores,
      verbose = FALSE
    )
    res_perm <- motif_edger(
      cellgraph = cperm,
      sample_df = sample_df,
      design_formula = as.formula(paste0("~ ", group_col)),
      verbose = FALSE
    )
    stack_layer_pvals(collect_layer_tables(res_perm, coef_name = coef_name), perm_id = i)
  }

  perm_pvals <- bind_rows(par_apply(perm_ids, run_perm, n_cores = n_cores))
  perm_ran <- TRUE
}
```

```{r cache-save}
if (perm_ran) {
  saveRDS(
    list(
      perm_pvals = perm_pvals,
      params = list(n_perm = n_perm, perm_seed = perm_seed)
    ),
    perm_cache
  )
  message("Saved permutation cache: ", perm_cache)
} else {
  message("Using existing permutation cache: ", perm_cache)
}
```

Summary: `r nrow(perm_pvals)` permuted motif p-values across `r length(unique(perm_pvals$layer))` layers.
